propers.name: Collect
propers.text:
Fac nos, Domine Deus, supereminentem Jesu Christi scientiam, spiritu Pauli
Apostoli, ediscere: qua beatus Antonius Maria mirabiliter eruditus, novas in
Ecclesia tua clericorum et virginum familias congregavit. Per eundem
Dominum.

Its Holy Week is the pre-1955 rite, its sanctoral is not the 1962 sanctoral, and its second and third orations are not those of 1962. It is carried only where a 1962 formulary is the same prayer, and nothing here may be used for recitation.

regnas cum Deo Patre in unitate.
